title: A different POST body never reaches the facilitator, even WITHOUT a configured resource
provenance: Same lines as body-never-reaches-facilitator-configured.json. This vector exists to show the body gap is unconditional: unlike the query string, it does not depend on whether routeConfig.resource is set, because req.originalUrl (used by the auto-derived path) never contains the POST body either.
note: Same path, same absent resource config, different bodies: still collapses. Contrast with query-distinguished-under-auto-resource.json, where removing the configured resource DOES restore a distinction, because the query string (unlike the body) lives inside req.originalUrl.
